text_en: Giant pandas live in the mountains of China.
Many years ago, pandas were endangered.
People cut down the bamboo forests, and pandas lost their habitat.
There were very few pandas left in the wild.
Then the government made new laws to protect them.
They created national parks and reserves.
Rangers guarded the forests, and scientists studied the pandas.
Zoos also helped to breed baby pandas.
Now the number of pandas is increasing.
They are still rare, but they are no longer endangered.
This story shows that we can save animals if we work together.
